programs.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programs.desc: Researchers begin excavations in places associated with events described in the Bible.Their discoveries shed new light on the most famous stories from the Holy Bible.

programs.title: Goulag: Une histoire soviétique
programs.desc: Millions of people were sent to forced labor camps in the USSR, including many Poles.Often their fate remained unknown.Not only criminals were sent there, but also political opponents and citizens who offended the system.Cheap labor in mines, quarries and logging was to support the economy.All documents have not yet been declassified.Knowledge about labor camps can be derived, among others, from literature - "The Gulag Archipelago" by Alexander Solzhenitsyn or "Another World" by Gustaw Herling-Grudziński.

programs.title: Air Crash Investigation
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of famous plane crashes.Viewers will see a reconstruction of the events that led to the tragedy.Fictionalized stories are complemented by accounts of pilots, experts, and witnesses..

programs.title: Abandoned Engineering: Season 13
programs.desc: There are many engineering projects in the world that have been abandoned for various reasons.The creators of the program present the stories of these structures and the people who created them.Behind each of them there is a fascinating and unique story.Viewers will discover the most spectacular examples of abandoned buildings from around the globe, including an underground Nazi base in France, designed to attack London, and a secret Japanese facility.We will find out why they were created and what led to their fall.
